reasoning: On the season so far the Cavaliers are the stronger team; with home court the Cavaliers start about 6 points better, in a game of about 246 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 3 points towards the Bulls.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Cavaliers (look-ahead).
Bottom line: the Cavaliers win 63 times in 100, by about 5; most games like this end between 220 and 268 total points.
